cases.prompt: Rank these raw ideas and tell me which deserve attention, including none if they are all weak.

Diagnose this recurring approval workflow and redesign the human, AI, and automation split.
Compare these consultants, find current alternatives, and brief a qualified choice.
Design the cheapest falsifiable experiment and keep an append-only result ledger.
Turn these talk notes into the minimum workshop package I actually need.
Create a control room for this multi-asset creative campaign.
Turn this session transcript into selected permission-safe reusable outputs.
Decide how this promising repeated method should be validated before becoming a reusable product.
I only have five unrelated ideas and no research yet. Which deserve investigation?
I do not have a research pack. Search what people are saying this month and cite it.
Here is completed research on three pricing policies. Decide which policy is best supported.
Here is research on three software tools. Choose a qualified tool for this job and write the handoff brief.
Redesign our intake workflow and include a small operational pilot outline.
The workflow is already designed. Precommit a prediction, sample, confounders, and result ledger for its test.

Track the brief, assets, owners, approvals, and delivery state for this campaign.
Inspect this one meeting transcript and recommend which internal outputs are worth creating.
